sloka: जलजानि च पुष्पाणि माल्यानि स्थलजानि च ।न अद्य भान्ति अल्प गन्धीनि फलानि च यथा पुरम् ॥२-५९-८॥
transliteration: jalajāni ca puṣpāṇi mālyāni sthalajāni ca ।na adya bhānti alpa gandhīni phalāni ca yathā puram ॥2-59-8॥

translations.english: O great king even trees with their flowers, buds and shoots throughout your empire have withered because of the calamity on Rama.
